f3_program: collection("nora.orange_pick_batches", "orange_batch", "nora_family.farm", source("Nora's mother tells her to go and pick oranges from their farm. She picks 80 oranges from one tree, 60 from another tree, and 120 from the third tree"))
member("nora.orange_pick_batches", "nora.orange_pick_batches.first_tree", source("80 oranges from one tree"))
observe(at("nora.orange_pick_batches.first_tree.count", "current"), 80, "count", source("80 oranges from one tree"))

transfer("pick_first_tree", "nora", at("nora_family.farm.first_tree.oranges.count", "current"), at("nora.picked_oranges.count", "current"), at("nora.orange_pick_batches.first_tree.count", "current"), source("She picks 80 oranges from one tree"))
member("nora.orange_pick_batches", "nora.orange_pick_batches.second_tree", source("60 from another tree"))
observe(at("nora.orange_pick_batches.second_tree.count", "current"), 60, "count", source("60 from another tree"))

transfer("pick_second_tree", "nora", at("nora_family.farm.second_tree.oranges.count", "current"), at("nora.picked_oranges.count", "current"), at("nora.orange_pick_batches.second_tree.count", "current"), source("60 from another tree"))
member("nora.orange_pick_batches", "nora.orange_pick_batches.third_tree", source("120 from the third tree"))
observe(at("nora.orange_pick_batches.third_tree.count", "current"), 120, "count", source("120 from the third tree"))

transfer("pick_third_tree", "nora", at("nora_family.farm.third_tree.oranges.count", "current"), at("nora.picked_oranges.count", "current"), at("nora.orange_pick_batches.third_tree.count", "current"), source("120 from the third tree"))
query("sum", "nora.orange_pick_batches", "current")

f3_program: collection("talent_show.signed_up_kids", "kid", "talent_show", source("There are 34 kids signed up to compete in the talent show"))
observe(at("talent_show.signed_up_kids.count", "current"), 34, "count", source("There are 34 kids signed up to compete in the talent show"))
offset(at("talent_show.signed_up_girls.count", "current"), at("talent_show.signed_up_boys.count", "current"), 22, "count", source("There are 22 more girls than boys signed up to compete"))

sum_relation(at("talent_show.signed_up_kids.count", "current"), at("talent_show.signed_up_girls.count", "current"), at("talent_show.signed_up_boys.count", "current"), source("There are 34 kids signed up to compete in the talent show. There are 22 more girls than boys signed up to compete."))
query("value", at("talent_show.signed_up_girls.count", "current"))
assumptions: The signed-up kids are partitioned into the girls and boys mentioned in the question.
